codeReview.summary: The commit at 49b3bf7 does wire request cancellation and a localized safety badge, but the feature is still overclaimed as complete. Several core cross-area flows remain unwired in current HEAD: voice-mode log drafts never reach the confirmation card, live voice turns are inserted into the main chat in reverse order, farm context is pinned to the first farm instead of the active farm, and sidebar resume truncates longer conversations.

issues.description: `handleRecordingComplete()` only forwards chat messages into the parent via `onNewMessage`, but it never propagates `response.voiceLogAction`. `ChatScreen` renders `ActivityConfirmCard` only from `useAssistant.voiceLogAction` (`src/components/assistant/ChatScreen.tsx:93` and `:407-411`), so a voice log draft returned by the backend cannot ever reach the confirmation UI. That means the required voice → extraction → confirmation card → add-entry navigation flow is not actually wired for voice mode.

The hook appends `response.message` to the main chat before the synthetic user transcript (`onNewMessage?.(response.message)` at line 179, then `onNewMessage?.(userChatMessage)` at line 191). `useAssistant.addMessage` appends in insertion order (`src/hooks/use-assistant.ts:260-261`) and `MessageList` renders `messages` as-is (`src/components/assistant/MessageList.tsx:57-60`), so closing voice mode shows each exchange as assistant-then-user instead of preserving the natural voice→text conversation order promised by the feature.

`ChatScreen` hard-codes assistant context to `farms?.[0]` and never reads any selected/active-farm state. That leaves no code path for the feature's 'farm switch mid-conversation uses the new farm's data' requirement: subsequent requests will keep using whichever farm happens to be first in the fetched array, not the farm the user actively switched to.

Conversation restore is truncated to the latest 20 turns by default, and `useAssistant.loadConversation()` does not override that limit (`src/hooks/use-assistant.ts:288`). The feature promises conversation persistence/resume from the sidebar, but longer chats will not reload their full history.
